title: phaseolus vulgaris var. chamoides
intro: Phaseolus vulgaris var. chamoides, commonly known as Japanese kidney bean or bush bean, is a variety of the common bean plant (Phaseolus vulgaris). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving blood sugar control due to its high fiber and antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of Phaseolus vulgaris var. chamoides include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties, which may help protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and diabetes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
